Plugin.Name: UGREEN LED Control
Plugin.Overview: LED control for UGREEN DX/DXP NAS devices. Set colour, brightness and effect for every front LED (static, breathe, pulse, rainbow, CPU temperature). In status mode the bay LEDs show disk activity, disabled or missing disks, rising SMART values, parity checks and rebuilds, spun-down disks (dimmed, off or slowly pulsing) and optionally each disk's temperature. The network LED shows traffic, only the link, or the negotiated link speed in a colour per speed (10M to 10G); the case picture draws every RJ45 port with its speed. The power LED blinks or breathes when Unraid shuts down or reboots, and shows unread Unraid alerts. Night mode, identify a bay, a compact dashboard tile, a dark or light interface, and English, German and Spanish. It talks to the LED controller over I2C without a kernel module, so Unraid updates don't break it, and it never wakes sleeping disks. Developed on a DXP6800 Pro, confirmed on the DXP4800 family and the DXP8800 Plus; the DXP480T Plus power LED is set to static white. Uninstall ugreenleds-driver first.
